description: At Collab International, we work to provide all the services that students may need when they begin their educational journey abroad. Our mission does not end with only giving professional counseling or admission support services to students in accordance with their education and career objectives, it also involves services such as detailed pre-admission evaluation, conducting enrollment procedures of colleges and universities, exam preparation, visa applications, accommodation arrangements, travel arrangements, insurance policies, suitable scholarship research and ongoing support during the program. We care for each student that applies to us and we work to provide them the full compliment of services to support them to reach their educational destination.
